tagline: Breed a family of Larrys, then spend them — every death draws Gerry another card

featuredCards.title: Breed
featuredCards.caption: Five copies, and each one adds a body and a card. The board fills up faster than it can be cleared.

featuredCards.title: Swarm
featuredCards.caption: Pulls every nearby isopod onto the target and counts them for value. Being surrounded is the point.

featuredCards.title: Cannibalize
featuredCards.caption: Eat one of the children to heal everyone standing near it — and the special ability pays a card for the loss.

featuredCards.title: Family sacrifice
featuredCards.caption: Two Larrys traded for +4 and two more cards. Grim arithmetic, and it wins fights.
